coverageGaps.detail: explorer-panel.test.ts asserts initExplorerSearch called once but does NOT assert resetExplorerSearch fires on panel close or project switch, despite TASK-004 AC-6 explicitly requiring those two assertions. The wiring is correct in code (renderTreeForActiveProject / closeTree both call resetExplorerSearch), but a regression removing those calls would not be caught.

Click-to-open (addFileReaderSession), reader reuse (findExistingFileReader), and relative-path resolution have zero automated coverage. Behavior is delegated to the pre-existing addFileReaderSession (verified correct), and TASK-004 AC-7 accepts manual QA for these, but there is no regression guard.

Recursive enumeration over unloaded dirs (AC-8) and ignore exclusion (node_modules/.git/.gitignore/hidden, AC-9) are satisfied only by reusing the pre-existing enumerateProjectFiles, which itself has no dedicated unit test. file-search.test.ts covers the pure matching function over path arrays only, not the enumeration/ignore layer.
